title: Latent Traits and Cross-Task Transfer: Deconstructing Dataset Interactions in LLM Fine-tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) plots of token lengths across predicted classes (True/False Positives and Negatives) to determine if fine-tuned models learn spurious correlations between input text length and specific labels (e.g., associating shorter sentences with positive sentiment).

Comparing the out-of-domain classification performance and confusion matrices of models fine-tuned on naturally imbalanced datasets versus artificially balanced datasets to detect skewed output prediction tendencies.
